title: Entanglement Area Law for 2D Gapped Quantum Systems
exact_target: Must entanglement in every uniformly gapped two-dimensional local ground state grow at most in proportion to a region's boundary?

sources.citation: I. Arad, R. Firanko, R. Jain, Area Laws and Tensor Networks for Maximally Mixed Ground States, Communications in Mathematical Physics 407, 54 (2026).
Universal lower bound on topological entanglement entropy.
